purpose: Normalize Windows provider image proofs so every lane is judged by the same transport, original-byte, local-save, validation and security criteria.

SESSION_API.definition: An authenticated user session is used to call the provider's observed HTTP/WebSocket application interface directly after session establishment; the browser UI is not required for each generation.
requirements: session belongs to the authorized principal
route is evidenced rather than guessed
no CAPTCHA, anti-abuse, quota or protection bypass
credential material remains opaque and is never copied into receipts

BROWSER_CDP.definition: A dedicated authorized browser profile owns authentication and generation is driven through browser automation/CDP while original result bytes are acquired from an evidenced browser-accessible source.
requirements: screenshots and rendered previews do not count as original bytes

HYBRID.definition: Browser automation owns authentication, bootstrap or recovery while an evidenced application/API/network route performs part of generation, polling or original-byte acquisition.
requirements: browser and API responsibilities are explicitly separated
all session material belongs to one authorized principal
the exact original-byte acquisition boundary is recorded

OFFICIAL_API.definition: A vendor-documented and allowed API or SDK is used with its documented authentication mechanism.
requirements: official route is identified by dated documentation or account evidence
provider response is not silently reinterpreted as success when image bytes are absent

UNSUPPORTED.definition: Evidence shows the tested provider/route does not expose the required native image generation plus durable original-byte export capability for this scope.

UNKNOWN.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to classify the transport or prove the required image capability without guessing.

must_not_be: cached historical artifact presented as new generation

original_bytes.definition: The durable provider-produced image payload at the highest evidenced original/export quality available to the tested route, not a screenshot, HTML canvas capture, thumbnail or UI preview unless the provider itself defines that payload as the downloadable original.
accepted_acquisition_examples: authorized downloadable original URL fetched successfully
browser download event yielding the provider's original file
